method.planet_radius: Rp/R_earth = 109.076 * stellar_radius_solar * sqrt(detector_source_flux_depth_ppm * 1e-6). Approximation assumes the source-flux preparation identifies the host and dilution correctly, and neglects transit geometry and limb-darkening effects. No native posterior is inferred.
method.stellar_radius: Use a positive finite TIC v8.2 radius when available; otherwise explicitly use the positive finite Gaia FLAME radius; leave missing radii null. Preserve both catalogue values and the selected provenance.
method.semimajor_axis: a/AU = (TIC_mass_solar * (period_days/365.25)^2)^(1/3); null without TIC mass. Neglect companion mass.
method.irradiation: L/L_sun = R_star^2*(Teff/5772)^4; S/S_earth = L/a^2. Conditional catalogue estimate, not a habitability classification.
method.temperature: T_eq = 278.3*(S/S_earth)^0.25 K, zero Bond albedo and uniform redistribution. Not a measured surface temperature.
method.size_bins: NASA Kepler descriptive radius bins: Earth-size <1.25; super-Earth-size [1.25,2); Neptune-size [2,6); giant-planet-size [6,22); above 22 R_earth separate. Size labels do not determine composition or mass.
method.window_overlap: Geometric overlap of the original supplied BOI windows from the same Gaia source and quarter; no new flux fitting or independence claim. Non-overlapping windows are not proof of independent planets.

limits: All original BOI dispositions, proposals, periods and frozen evidence remain unchanged.
Approximate radii are not accepted physical fits, posterior measurements, validation or novelty results.
Size counts count BOI proposals and may include aliases or duplicated photons.
Host catalogue discrepancies are preserved. Cohort M/K labels are not replaced by catalogue temperature descriptions.
No existing accepted study radius is overwritten. In particular the KIC 6699887 15-day adopted radius remains 2.659 [2.503,2.861] Earth radii; the overview proxy is separately identified.
No new probability integrations, transit fits, catalogue searches or detector calibrations are performed.
candidate_table_export: UTF-8 CSV with LF line endings; values preserved from the server report.
